WITH grouped_data AS (
  SELECT 
    ili.order_item_id,
    p.product_color,
    AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) as avg_quantity,
    AVG((ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) / ili.derived_total_cost) as avg_formula
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  INNER JOIN Order_Items oi ON ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  INNER JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, p.product_color
),
ranked_data AS (
  SELECT 
    order_item_id,
    product_color,
    avg_quantity,
    avg_formula,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_color ORDER BY avg_quantity DESC NULLS LAST) as rank_within_color
  FROM grouped_data
)
SELECT 
  order_item_id,
  product_color,
  avg_quantity,
  avg_formula,
  rank_within_color
FROM ranked_data
WHERE rank_within_color <= 3
ORDER BY product_color, rank_within_color;

assumptions.assumption: Invoice_Line_Items.product_quantity (defined as VARCHAR(50)) contains numeric values or NULL that can be cast to DECIMAL(19,4) for averaging.
